follow-up time: Not specified, but likely short-term post-operative period
exposure: Type of caesarean section (elective vs. non-elective)
Gestational age at delivery (term vs. preterm)
cohort: 821 women who underwent caesarean section in a single tertiary hospital during 2017
finding: While there was no difference in the overall prevalence of positive uterine cultures between elective and non-elective caesarean sections, obtaining routine intrauterine cultures during non-elective caesarean sections might be useful for detecting significant pathogens and tailoring antibiotic treatment for postpartum endometritis.
